audit.why: All-Xerath chart agrees across packet, full and content layers — boot-less short-range Cassiopeia vs 750+ artillery is Xerath-favoured at every stage. No chart edits needed.
Spikes accurate: 3-5 zoning window, 6 off-screen ult pressure vs her 825-range R, 1st item still ahead, late poke-before-ramp.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields called Cassiopeia 'he/his'; tradeBad and dosFull[0].d described a dash/grounding interaction that does not exist for dash-less Xerath; cooldowns field had no number; anti-heal and channel-cancel interactions were absent from the full layer.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is she/her (champ-gender.js). Miasma's grounding is irrelevant against Xerath (no movement abilities) — its value here is the 24s-cooldown slow zone. Twin Fang heals her (anti-heal matters). Petrifying Gaze (120s) can cancel Rite of the Arcane's channel.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, Miasma reframed as slow-zone with real cooldowns, anti-heal kept in report[8], channel-cancel folded into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Miasma 24s rank 1 and Petrifying Gaze 120s are the punishable windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Channel-punished (her R cancels your R) unstated.
